Risk Scenario: If regulated data is processed or stored outside approved jurisdictions, Northstar may breach contractual and regulatory data residency obligations.

Risk Scenario: If master data quality controls remain absent, financial and operational reporting may be materially inaccurate, undermining management decisions.
